title: Normalized Agent Trajectory (as persisted)
description: One atomic event per step. This schema describes the ACTUAL format the adapters produce and cache (data/cache/normtraj/<agent>/<instance>.json = schema_version + NormalizedTrajectory.to_dict()); tests/test_schema_conformance.py keeps it honest — the previous revision documented an aspirational envelope (task/agent/run/gold_reference/derived_signals) that no code ever produced or consumed. Ordering contract: step_id is monotone WITHIN a thread (subagent_id); the Claude Code adapter appends sub-agent threads after the main thread, so cross-thread step_id comparisons are meaningless — ordering-derived signals must filter to one thread (see awe.trajsignals). The affordance-fairness rule (never flag an agent for not using an action its scaffold cannot perform) is carried by the canonical_action ontology + per-adapter mapping, not by a persisted affordance list.

schema_version.description: awe.trajectory.SCHEMA_VERSION at write time; mismatched cache entries are recomputed, never served.

source.description: Original source path, byte size and SHA-256; step references point into this immutable artifact.

step_id.description: Monotone within a thread (see ordering contract above).

turn_id.description: Groups steps from one native log record. NOT comparable across adapters (raw line index for Codex, message index for CC/OpenCode).

canonical_action.description: Cross-scaffold action ontology; native_tool keeps the original name for fairness. plan (schema 20): an explicit plan / todo-list update (TodoWrite, todowrite, update_plan) whose args.items carry [{content, status}].

args.description: Tool-call args (command/pattern/path...). On a tool_result, may carry exit_code (int) when the scaffold reports one — the ground-truth success signal that overrides text heuristics. Schema 19: adapters deliver it for OpenCode (metadata.exit), Codex ('Process exited with code N' header) and Claude Code ('Exit code N' text); a Codex write_stdin continuation result also carries continuation_of (the originating call_id).

files.description: Repo-relative paths touched. For run_command steps these are best-effort READ targets (redirect/heredoc write targets excluded — they feed the read-set).

test_run.description: The command is a test invocation (runner as command head / -m target / test script / known phrase — not a substring match).

tool_error.description: Explicit scaffold error flag on a tool_result.

output_excerpt.description: Complete observed tool output. Legacy field name retained; renderers apply their own display budgets.

call_id.description: Links tool_call to its tool_result. May be null for linkage-less logs; consumers fall back positionally.

observability.description: hidden = encrypted/absent reasoning (e.g. Codex): consumers MUST NOT infer 'ignored X' from absence.

subagent_id.description: Thread id for delegated sub-agent steps; null = main thread.
